title: Legends from Lacoytas: The First Seeker
description:
Legends from Lacoytas: The First Seeker is a challenging top down shooter where you are given a crossbow and sword to shoot and slash your way through unique enemies.Features• Challenging combat that requires players to constantly adapt based on their available weapons and the current enemies.

• At least 4 normal enemies.

• At least 4 bosses.

• A short story focused mode in which you will save a village from local bandits and can learn more about the protagonist.

• An endless mode where you will fight infinite waves of randomly selected enemies. What's the highest score you can achieve?

• An overpowered floor.
description_short: The First Seeker is a challenging top down shooter where you will shoot and slash your way through enemies.
